channel.title: Daily brief - Martin Jordanovski
channel.description: AI, technology and software development news, summarised every morning. Leadership, psychology and investing on Mondays.

item.title: Daily brief, 25 Nov 2026
item.description:
Tidal to ban fully AI-generated music from December 9: Tidal will ban fully AI-generated music on December 9 and remove about 29 million such tracks. It expects to reject roughly 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day. Songs with AI assistance will still be accepted.
Active intrusion campaign targets Check Point security management servers: An ongoing intrusion campaign against Check Point security management servers is drawing attention in the developer community. Details beyond the report's existence are limited in the available item.
Microsoft declares internal 'Code Red' after near-24-hour Outlook and Exchange outage: A nearly 24-hour Exchange Online and Outlook outage cut off email for millions of customers. Microsoft traced it to a bug that had sat on Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers, and it has since declared an internal 'Code Red'.
